label: prf:strangelet-crossing-energy
title: Proof of strangelet crossing energy
html:
Proof. Proof of strangelet crossing energy

Proof. (1) The up quark occupies a color tube with positive orientation (+2/3 charge). The down and strange quarks occupy tubes with negative orientation (-1/3 each). The Coulomb charge Q = \frac{1}{2}(n_+ - n_-) vanishes by the partition \{+, -, -\}, independent of knot type.

(2) This is immediate from \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{cross}} = \text{strong} + Q \cdot (q - q^{-1}) with Q = 0.

(3) The crossing count follows from the braid index. The trefoil T_{2,3} has minimal braid word \sigma_1^3 (3 crossings). The cinquefoil T_{2,5} has \sigma_1^5 (5 crossings). Under mirror reflection, T_{2,5}^{\sigma} has 5 negative crossings. The binding component n_- \cdot q^{-1} is larger for strange matter by a factor of 8/6 = 4/3. \square
